title: Oppression of Midian (7 years)
summary: Israel is delivered into the hand of Midian seven years; Midianites, Amalekites and the children of the east devour the land (Judg 6:1–6).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1258 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: 7 years of "MIDIAN", 1258 BC to 1251 BC ("1251 BC GIDEON'S 300 WIN")
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band

chronologies.date: 2752d AM, 1252 BC ("This fourth oppression lasted 7 years")
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §354 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

chronologies.date: "2766 - End of Barak's Northern peace and Ehud's Central peace, beginning of Midianite oppression (Jud. 6:1)."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry.

chronologies.date: "2740 - End of Barak's Northern peace and Ehud's Central peace, beginning of Midianite oppression (Jud. 6:1). We can be certain of this date as a result of counting backwards from Judges 11:16 and 1 Kings 6:1."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). Text: "beginning in A.M. 2740, or 180 years after the division of the land in 2560." ("Judges 11:16" is Jordan's reference as printed; the 300-year verse is Judg 11:26.) BC 5:2: "The Midianites oppressed the North beginning in 2740".
